_comment: Feature catalog for the Fenix release test planner PoC. Each entry binds a user-facing feature to (a) the production source it lives in, (b) the efficiency-framework page objects that drive it, and (c) test class name patterns. Severity is the FMEA S factor, 1-10, judged on blast radius if the feature breaks in a release build.

_severity_scale.10: Silent data loss, privacy/security leak, or app unusable. Ships = chemspill.
_severity_scale.9: Core journey broken or trust boundary weakened. Ships = dot release.
_severity_scale.8: Major feature broken for all users of it. Highly visible.
_severity_scale.7: Major feature degraded, or broken on a common path.
_severity_scale.6: Secondary feature broken. Noticeable, has workarounds.

features.name: Core Browsing & Navigation
features.severity_rationale: Every session passes through it; a break makes the app unusable.

features.name: Home Screen
features.severity_rationale: First surface on every cold start; breakage blocks all entry points.

features.name: Search & Suggestions
features.severity_rationale: Primary navigation mechanism and a revenue surface.

features.name: Tabs & Tabs Tray
features.severity_rationale: Session state lives here; failures can lose user tabs.

features.name: Private Browsing & PBM Lock
features.severity_rationale: Trust boundary. A leak of private state is a privacy incident.

features.name: Enhanced Tracking Protection
features.severity_rationale: Core brand promise and a security control; silent failure is worst case.

features.name: IP Protection / VPN
features.severity_rationale: Security feature where silent failure misleads users about their protection.

features.name: Downloads
features.severity_rationale: Touches storage and permissions; failures can lose user files.

features.name: Bookmarks
features.severity_rationale: User-generated data; corruption is unrecoverable without sync.

features.name: History
features.severity_rationale: User data plus a privacy surface when deletion fails.

features.name: Logins & Passwords
features.severity_rationale: Credential store. Data loss or exposure is a security incident.

features.name: Address & Credit Card Autofill
features.severity_rationale: Stores PII and payment data; incorrect fill can leak between fields.

features.name: Delete Browsing Data
features.severity_rationale: Privacy control. Failing to actually delete is a trust violation.

features.name: Site Permissions
features.severity_rationale: Gates camera, mic and location. Over-granting is a security bug.

features.name: HTTPS-Only Mode
features.severity_rationale: Transport security control; silent downgrade is a security bug.

features.name: Custom Tabs
features.severity_rationale: Third-party app integration surface; breakage affects external partners.

features.name: Main Menu
features.severity_rationale: Entry point to most secondary features; breakage blocks many journeys.

features.name: Onboarding
features.severity_rationale: Every new user sees it; a break damages activation and is highly visible.

features.name: Startup & Performance
features.severity_rationale: Startup regressions affect 100% of sessions and are release blockers.

features.name: Crash Reporting
features.severity_rationale: Loss of crash telemetry blinds the release team during the cycle.

features.name: Firefox Account & Sync
features.severity_rationale: Cross-device data movement; failures can duplicate or drop records.

features.name: Add-ons & Extensions
features.severity_rationale: Opt-in surface, but broken add-ons draw loud community feedback.

features.name: Share
features.severity_rationale: Common outbound action; integrates with the system share sheet.

features.name: PWAs & Home Screen Shortcuts
features.severity_rationale: Installed shortcuts persist on the device; breakage is sticky.

features.name: Google Lens Integration
features.severity_rationale: New entry flow that takes camera permission; a failure is both a broken feature and a permissions surface.

features.name: Collections
features.severity_rationale: User-generated grouping; lower traffic than bookmarks.

features.name: Reader View
features.severity_rationale: Secondary reading surface with an accessibility dimension.

features.name: Find in Page
features.severity_rationale: Self-contained utility; failure is contained to the feature.

features.name: Translations
features.severity_rationale: Newer opt-in feature; incorrect translation is visible but non-destructive.

features.name: Nimbus Experiments & Messaging
features.severity_rationale: Controls rollout of everything else; a break can mis-target experiments.

features.name: Telemetry & Data Collection
features.severity_rationale: Data quality issue rather than user-facing, but blinds decision making.

features.name: Accessibility
features.severity_rationale: Regressions here exclude users entirely and carry compliance risk.

features.name: Media Playback & Notifications
features.severity_rationale: Background playback and notification controls; visible when broken.

features.name: Push & Notifications
features.severity_rationale: Delivery surface for re-engagement; failures are silent.

features.name: Theming, Wallpapers & App Icon
features.severity_rationale: Largely cosmetic; contained blast radius.

features.name: Web Compat Reporter
features.severity_rationale: Reporting utility; failure does not affect browsing.

features.name: Microsurveys & Review Prompt
features.severity_rationale: Peripheral prompt surface; worst case is an annoying dialog.

features.name: Page Summarization
features.severity_rationale: New opt-in AI surface with limited rollout.

features.name: Terms of Use & Distributions
features.severity_rationale: Legal acceptance gate and partner build config; blocks first run when broken.

features.name: Settings (General & Shell)
features.severity_rationale: Container for most controls; a broken settings shell blocks many features.

features.name: App Infrastructure & Components
features.severity_rationale: Shared plumbing. Changes here can destabilise every feature at once.

features.name: Build, Gradle & Manifest
features.severity_rationale: Build config errors ship broken binaries or wrong permissions to everyone.

features.name: Strings & Localization
features.severity_rationale: String-only changes; risk is truncation or an untranslated surface.

features.name: Layouts, Drawables & UI Resources
features.severity_rationale: Visual and layout regressions; can break interaction if a view id changes.
